title: Cancellation of normalized tensor representative cubes
statement: For two categories of representatives with fixed tensor representatives and two target tensor models, package the exact realization functors, factors, representative isomorphisms and their normalization equations. If a pair of pullback functors has representative equations, its exact factors agree with the ordinary realization mate, and the ordinary chain tensor square commutes, then the specified derived curried tensor square commutes on representatives. This is a general categorical cancellation statement and constructs no new comparison.

source.place: Tags 07A4 and 07A6; representative cancellation in the scalar tensor-pullback square

proof.text: Uncurry the realization isomorphisms. Precompose by the source representative isomorphism under the pullback and realization functors. Postcompose by the tensor of the composite localization factors and ordinary mate. Expand both paths using the four representative equations; use naturality of the tensor transformations, realization isomorphisms and localization factors. Substitute the unary factor equation and the chain tensor square, and cancel the two isomorphisms. Convert back to curried components. Treat the ordinary tensor functors as explicit data throughout; all arguments use only naturality, representative equations and cancellation.

theorem finiteScalarRepresentativeTensorCube
    {K H K' H' D E D' E' : Type*}
    [Category K] [Category H]
    [Category K'] [Category H'] [Category D] [Category E] [Category D'] [Category E']
    (Y : ScalarTensorRepresentativeData K K' D D')
    (X : ScalarTensorRepresentativeData H H' E E')
    (A : K ⥤ H) (B : K' ⥤ H')
    (F : D ⥤ E) (G : D' ⥤ E')
    (f : Y.q ⋙ F ≅ A ⋙ X.q) (g : Y.q' ⋙ G ≅ B ⋙ X.q')
    (c : Y.U ⋙ B ≅ A ⋙ X.U) (alpha : Y.E ⋙ G ≅ F ⋙ X.E)
    (hA : ∀ P, Y.P P → X.P (A.obj P))
    (hB : ∀ P, Y.P' P → X.P' (B.obj P))
    (mF : Y.t ⋙ A ⟶
      (A.prod A) ⋙ X.t)
    (mG : Y.t' ⋙ B ⟶ (B.prod B) ⋙ X.t')
    (phiF : (postcompose₂.obj F).obj Y.T ⟶
      (((whiskeringLeft₂ E).obj F).obj F).obj X.T)
    (phiG : Y.T' ⋙ G ⟶ (G.prod G) ⋙ X.T')
    (hf : ∀ (P Q : K) (hp : Y.P P) (hq : Y.P Q),
      F.map (Y.r.hom.app (⟨P, hp⟩, ⟨Q, hq⟩)) ≫
          (phiF.app (Y.q.obj P)).app (Y.q.obj Q) ≫
          (uncurry.obj X.T).map (Prod.mkHom (f.hom.app P) (f.hom.app Q)) =
        f.hom.app (Y.t.obj (P, Q)) ≫
          X.q.map (mF.app (P, Q)) ≫
          X.r.hom.app (⟨A.obj P, hA P hp⟩, ⟨A.obj Q, hA Q hq⟩))
    (hg : ∀ (P Q : K') (hp : Y.P' P) (hq : Y.P' Q),
      G.map (Y.r'.hom.app (⟨P, hp⟩, ⟨Q, hq⟩)) ≫
          phiG.app (Y.q'.obj P, Y.q'.obj Q) ≫
          X.T'.map (Prod.mkHom (g.hom.app P) (g.hom.app Q)) =
        g.hom.app (Y.t'.obj (P, Q)) ≫ X.q'.map (mG.app (P, Q)) ≫
          X.r'.hom.app (⟨B.obj P, hB P hp⟩, ⟨B.obj Q, hB Q hq⟩))
    (hc : ∀ P : K,
      X.E.map (f.hom.app P) ≫ X.e.hom.app (A.obj P) ≫ X.q'.map (c.inv.app P) =
        alpha.inv.app (Y.q.obj P) ≫ G.map (Y.e.hom.app P) ≫ g.hom.app (Y.U.obj P))
    (ht : ∀ P Q : K,
      X.U.map (mF.app (P, Q)) ≫ X.b.app (A.obj P, A.obj Q) ≫
          X.t'.map (Prod.mkHom (c.inv.app P) (c.inv.app Q)) =
        c.inv.app ((Y.t).obj (P, Q)) ≫
          B.map (Y.b.app (P, Q)) ≫ mG.app (Y.U.obj P, Y.U.obj Q))
    (P Q : K) (hp : Y.P P) (hq : Y.P Q) :
    X.E.map ((phiF.app (Y.q.obj P)).app (Y.q.obj Q)) ≫
        (X.tau.hom.app (F.obj (Y.q.obj P))).app (F.obj (Y.q.obj Q)) =
      alpha.inv.app ((Y.T.obj (Y.q.obj P)).obj (Y.q.obj Q)) ≫
        G.map ((Y.tau.hom.app (Y.q.obj P)).app (Y.q.obj Q)) ≫
        ((curry.map phiG ≫ (curryObjProdComp G G X.T').hom).app
          (Y.E.obj (Y.q.obj P))).app (Y.E.obj (Y.q.obj Q)) ≫
        ((curry.obj X.T').map (alpha.hom.app (Y.q.obj P))).app _ ≫
        ((curry.obj X.T').obj _).map (alpha.hom.app (Y.q.obj Q))
